answer: A concrete approach: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The velvet of work and the pearl of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a wharf to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
